name: Account Link 7
definition: Defines how the securities account is linked to the cash account.

SecuritiesAccount.name: Securities Account
SecuritiesAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account to or from which a cash entry is made.

ValidFrom.name: Valid From
ValidFrom.definition: Defines the date since when the securities account is linked to the cash account.

ValidTo.name: Valid To
ValidTo.definition: Defines the date until when the securities account is linked to the cash account.

DefaultIndicator.name: Default Indicator
DefaultIndicator.definition: Specifies whether created account link is set as default for settlement.

CollateralisationIndicator.name: Collateralisation Indicator
CollateralisationIndicator.definition: Specifies whether market infrastructure can use the securities, earmarked as collateral and held on the securities account, for auto-collateralisation operations on the linked market infrastructure dedicated cash account.

CashSettlementIndicator.name: Cash Settlement Indicator
CashSettlementIndicator.definition: Specifies whether market infrastructure can use the link between the securities account and the market infrastructure dedicated cash account for the settlement of the cash leg of a settlement instruction.

SecuritiesAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Rul.definition: If SecuritiesAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

SecuritiesAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Rul.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SecuritiesAccount must be absent.

SecuritiesAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Rul.definition: Either SecuritiesAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.
